key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence enabled OpenPerov to guide perovskite solar-cell design, selecting a contact that delivered 27.05% power conversion efficiency.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI could help engineers select materials and design discriminating experiments for more efficient, thermally stable solar cells.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 training articles.
Adapt models using links between experimental strategies, controls, observations and mechanisms.
Refine selected answers with retrieved evidence and experimentally test a proposed contact.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; the selected contact yielded devices retaining 96.74% efficiency after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85°C.
watch_item: The reported dark thermal-ageing result does not establish durability under illumination or outdoor operating conditions.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
